_comment: Structured failure recovery. When a step fails, returns empty, or is blocked, look up the failure mode and apply the concrete actions instead of giving up. Mirrors a delegate/retry-guidance pattern, adapted to Blitz Strike's deterministic tools.

modes.signal: a detector returns empty for a file/target that clearly contains a sink or entry point
actions: reload the MCP server (/reload-mcp) — a stale server after an upgrade is a silent false negative, not a clean result
re-run the same detector once
escalate to a deeper detector: blitz_scan -> eagle_eye2 -> route_scan / complex_scan
check the argument name — source-analysis tools take `path`, not `target`

modes.signal: a live probe is blocked by a WAF, filter, or sanitizer
actions: bypass_lookup(defense) for concrete techniques (encoding, case, comment insertion, chunked, null byte, double-encoding)
apply one technique at a time and re-probe
if still blocked, move the injection to another context (header, body, path, cookie)

modes.signal: a sink appears neutralized by a sanitizer
actions: challenge the sanitizer: loose == vs ===, missing EXTR_SKIP, int cast truncation, weak regex
test an evasion: double-encoding, unicode normalization, case mixing

modes.signal: a delegated sub-agent returns empty, errors, or prose without evidence
actions: re-delegate with a more specific goal + exact tool names + exact argument names (path vs target)
require deterministic output (file:line, sink, chain) — never prose
fall back to calling the tool yourself if the sub-agent cannot reach the MCP tools

modes.signal: a sub-agent/model returns a rate-limit, quota, context-length, or model-unavailable error
actions: model_fallback(signal) to classify the error and get the exact recovery — retryable? backoff? fall back / shrink scope / fix credentials / abort
do not fall back blindly: the class decides retry vs fallback vs shrink
run the step yourself with granular tools if the model cannot recover

modes.signal: a hypothesis is not confirmed live
actions: keep it as a hypothesis — do not drop it
try an alternate verification path
let adversarial review decide confirmed vs false_positive vs needs_more_evidence

modes.signal: only a low-severity finding is found
actions: list_chains + chain_links to see how it escalates
trace the full chain, not just the first sink

modes.signal: a live request or a full engagement times out on a slow/unresponsive target
actions: split into lighter probes: live_recon or active_scan first (fewer requests) instead of the full run_engagement
re-run run_engagement with an explicit scope so it skips the scope-gate retry loop
target a single endpoint (e.g. /signup) rather than the whole host to cut request volume
free-tier PaaS (onrender/heroku/railway) cold-starts: retry once after a short wait
